title: Sign-in demo: video landing, Google, weekly push

message.text: The page is built and live on staging: https://staging.lew42.com/join/ (video, one button, settings, in-app card, ?debug=1). The backend is live too: sessions, web push, sign out, delete account, weekly Monday push. Real Google sign-in waits on one step only you can do: add https://staging.lew42.com to the Google client's Authorized JavaScript origins. Now: a staging walk-through and a fresh review, then the merge.

Landed. /join/ is merged and live on staging: https://staging.lew42.com/join/ . A first visit is 2 taps: Continue with Google, then Allow one notification a week. Settings sit under your avatar (Sign out, Turn off notifications, Delete account), and ?debug=1 shows the state. Your phone checklist: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/signin-demo/checklist.md . One step only you can do: add https://staging.lew42.com to the Google client's Authorized JavaScript origins. After that, a real notification on your phone is the last unproven piece (headless browsers can't subscribe).

Done and landed. The page: https://staging.lew42.com/join/ . Your phone test: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/signin-demo/checklist.md . The page's own readme is public/join/readme.md, now linked from the root readme. Waiting on you: add https://staging.lew42.com to the Google client's Authorized JavaScript origins, then try it on your phone.
